img.alt: Pixel-art banner: a foggy prehistoric swamp on the upper left meets a bioluminescent prehistoric ocean on the lower right along a 30-degree diagonal. A carnivorous plant and a spiral ammonite fossil anchor the foreground; a glowing ammonite swims through the ocean. The name VynJustHumant glows in cyan-magenta neon at top centre.

main.p: A Y2K retro-futurist diorama split along a 30-degree seam: a fog-drowned Carboniferous swamp on one side, a bioluminescent abyssal ocean on the other. A carnivorous plant and a spiral ammonite fossil hold the foreground while an ammonite drifts through the light rays, trailing plankton like a signal.

section.p: FOG · RAYS · FERNS · WATER · FOSSIL · PLANT · AMMONITE · PARTICLES
